title: Future Juice Butterscotch & Custard 10ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Butterscotch & Custard is a rich and indulgent blend that combines the deep, caramelised notes of Butterscotch with the smooth, velvety warmth of classic Custard. The inhale delivers a buttery, golden sweetness, while the creamy Custard rounds out the flavour with a luxuriously smooth exhale, making this an ideal vape for dessert lovers. This nic salt e-liquid provides a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The 50% VG / 50% PG formula ensures a consistent flavour experience with discreet vapour production, making it perfect for pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this 10ml e-liquid caters to vapers seeking a lower, moderate, or higher nicotine level. Future Juice is a UK-based brand committed to crafting bold and satisfying flavour profiles, blending classic and contemporary taste experiences into high-quality e-liquids designed for everyday enjoyment.
